study.question: Does the incumbent global norm block help through scalar dispersion among four pooled field means, the retained normalized summed-mean direction, or their multiplicative interaction, with identical visible history and allocated capacity?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g1-r0009-global_norm has validation AUC 0.6200937865 versus 0.6193157645 for global_compact (delta +0.0007780220), with identical 17159459 allocated parameters. However r0008 norm_match and norm_rank lost to corresponding contrasts by about 0.00055 and 0.00049; norm compression is not generally established. The global collapsed block is E*u, where E is the norm of three orthogonal field-mean contrasts and u is the repeated zero-safe unit direction of the summed field mean. I hypothesize that E provides useful explicit pooled-field dispersion and u is dispensable. For means m_c,m_b,m_a,m_r, E^2=sum_j||m_j||^2-||sum_j m_j||^2/4=(1/4)sum_{i<j}||m_i-m_j||^2. This is dispersion of four learned FIELD MEANS, not event variance, behavioral diversity, uncertainty or reliability. Both parts can act through gradients and nonlinear reparameterization; this experiment does not identify a semantic field metric.

nearest_work.difference: Direct parent already computes E*u. New scalar candidate removes u with a fixed unit direction. Presence controls remove E, giving a full amplitude-by-direction factorial. This is a local mechanism refinement, not a claim to invent norms, pooling, quadratic interactions or compression.

DIN motivates candidate-dependent weighted pooling. The current model instead inherits exact category/brand match groups and fixed summaries, with no neural event scorer. Retained dormant attention is allocation only. Baseline is field-adapted, not exact author reproduction.
Only author field warning verified: history contains category, brand and behavior type, no item ID. No DMR full-paper or algorithm-equivalence claim; publisher text remains unavailable.

UniDot explicitly routes per-layer dot products through an FM Highway and shares sequence embeddings. Shared embedding execution is inherited from r0009, held fixed and not re-attributed here. E^2 also involves norms and dot products, so no novelty claim for explicit quadratic features. Current scalar is one pooled-field contrast norm into a shallow MLP, without a highway, buses, added supervision or source optimizer.

Reviews all five relevant source systems as external pCVR reports. No source-specific transport, old-history stack, token allocation or learned-query mechanism is added. No transfer or priority claim is verified by these summaries.

inherited_components: All parent embedding tables, action/recency encodings, dormant attention allocation and MLP layer construction order.
Semantic target match partitions, log-count features, observed group action-age table and independent content/context moment features.
Global compact field pooling and zero-safe orthogonal contrast norm.
One embedding lookup per history field per forward, inherited from controlled r0009 execution work.
Frozen host causal preprocessing, scorer, recipe and label visibility.
study.proposed_difference: Replace only the appended global readout with the four cells {energy,presence} x {mean,fixed}. Candidate energy_scalar retains E alone as E times a fixed all-ones unit vector in R^48; all coordinates are active. energy_mean exactly retains parent E*u. presence_mean retains u for nonempty history. presence_scalar retains only history presence. Every cell builds the same modules in the same order and computes every alternative before selecting its output. This matches allocated capacity and forward readout arithmetic, not effective rank or backward work. No measured efficiency or external novelty claim is made. All modules are standalone and training remains host-owned.
predictions: Energy_scalar will improve presence_scalar in validation AUC if scalar field-mean energy adds useful end-to-end information beyond existing means, counts and moments.

Energy_scalar will be within 0.0003 AUC and 0.0001 Logloss of concurrent energy_mean if retained mean direction is dispensable. These are exploratory decision tolerances, not significance/equivalence margins.
If field energy is broadly useful, the energy factor should help at both directions; a strong factorial interaction instead favors coupling or optimization explanations.

Source-derived diagnostic invariants: parent energy_mean block unchanged, legacy base features agree within floating point tolerance, energy recovered from the fixed lift, squared energy equals centered field-mean norm, direction replacements preserve block norm, masked/empty/zero-length histories produce no history features, event-order and within-match action-age-bundle reversals leave features unchanged up to floating-point summation.

Performance reporting uses full validation AUC primary, unweighted Logloss secondary, all four raw outcomes and simple effects; report host time, parameters, peak memory, throughput and batch latency separately. No equal-compute dominance follows from equal passes.
falsifiers: If presence_scalar matches or beats energy_scalar, the scalar-energy-information account is unsupported for this implementation, not refuted generally.
If presence_mean matches or beats energy_mean, the energy-specific explanation of parent gain is unsupported; retain scaling and optimizer alternatives.
If energy_mean clearly exceeds energy_scalar, discard sufficiency of scalar energy under this recipe and inspect interaction rather than claiming mean direction dispensable.
If the concurrent parent no longer retains its historical advantage, treat r0009 winner selection/seed variation as unresolved and do not declare a mechanism from its earlier maximum.

Any nonfinite diagnostic/logit, wrong output shape, parent mismatch above justified numerical tolerance (initial flag 1e-4 for max feature/energy errors), padding/empty failure or unauthorized information access invalidates interpretation pending correction. Host failures are charged and unknown execution state is not automatically retried.
Persistent disagreement across paired seeds or no useful admissible follow-up blocks a robust mechanism conclusion; no held-out test is authorized.
alternative_explanations: All embeddings are trained jointly: changing the readout changes gradients; this tests end-to-end mechanisms, not an invariant pretrained energy feature.
Identical allocated parameter count does not match effective input rank: fixed direction is rank one, mean direction has up to 16 degrees of freedom duplicated across three rows.
Presence uses prospective unit magnitude rather than a fitted energy scale; feature scaling, regularization and optimization remain alternatives.
One seed and validation reuse cannot establish significance, noninferiority, generalization or novelty.
The normalized mean is already recoverable nonlinearly from semantic means and counts, so direction benefits may reflect explicit reparameterization rather than new visible information.
Energy is also derivable from global field means but those are mixed in parent summaries; retained energy may capture embedding scale or field imbalance rather than a meaningful discrepancy.

Latest historical best may reflect winner selection over many validation trials; r0009 shared-rank AUC 0.6190113 versus r0008 fields_rank 0.6193665 despite same-checkpoint exact legacy equivalence is a warning about optimization/numerical trajectories.

Successful execution and unsuccessful science are distinct: behavior_within AUC 0.6119129 trails DIN 0.6133620; joint-count 0.6171272 nearly equals independent-count 0.6171230; count-only summary 0.6130946 loses to attention plus counts. Semantic grouped means 0.6187999 and paired action-age tables 0.6191088 provided more promising earlier trajectories; independent moments 0.6192439 did not support content-context covariance. These inherited single-seed comparisons are context, not new independent evidence.
